title: sonchus sinuatus
intro: Sonchus sinuatus, commonly known as the Wavy-leaved sowthistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sonchus sinuatus include its ability to act as a hepatoprotective agent, supporting liver health, and its potential to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
